toegepas.voor: en met behulp van die sterre kalenders gemaak
toegepas.na: en kalenders met behulp van die sterre gemaak
toegepas.rede_vinder: With 'sterre' and 'kalenders' side by side a young reader can stumble over 'sterre kalenders' as one phrase; putting the object first removes the ambiguity without changing the meaning.
toegepas.fout: 'die sterre kalenders' stand side by side and can be misread as one phrase ('sterrekalenders') on a first reading.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Putting the object before the adverbial phrase removes the stumble without changing who made what or how, and it does not undo the previous round's 'met behulp van'.

toegepas.voor: Hulle het self party van die style gebruik.
toegepas.na: Hulle het self party van Egipte se style gebruik.
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'die style' has no antecedent because styles were not mentioned before; naming whose styles makes the reference clear.
toegepas.fout: 'die style' has no antecedent; styles were not mentioned before, so the reader must infer whose styles.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Egipte se style' anchors the reference to the previous sentence's subject and adds no new fact.

laat_vaar.voor: het elke vier jaar 'n ekstra dag gekry
laat_vaar.na: het elke vier jaar 'n ekstra dag bygekry
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'bygekry' is the natural Afrikaans verb for an added day and says more precisely that the day was added.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'n ekstra dag gekry' is natural and clear; 'bygekry' next to 'ekstra' is a lateral move that only doubles the idea of addition.

na_skrywer.voor: 'n Volk van handelaars en seevaarders, veral aan die kus van vandag se Libanon.
na_skrywer.na: 'n Volk van handelaars en seevaarders wat veral aan die kus van vandag se Libanon gewoon het.
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: The trailing 'veral aan die kus' has no verb to attach to; a short relative clause makes the definition a complete, readable phrase (the reviewer may prefer to send this to the writer because it adds the verb 'gewoon').
na_skrywer.fout: The definition ends on a loose locative ('veral aan die kus ...') with nothing to attach to, which reads slightly elliptical.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: It is a glossary definition and the proposal adds content ('gewoon het', past tense), so any rewording belongs to the writer, for every lesson that uses the term.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'Voortbou op' is the idiomatic verb for building further on what was learnt; plain 'bou' reads literally.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'daarop bou' is already natural, plain Afrikaans for a Grade 5 reader; 'voortbou' only reads differently.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: was dit sowat 3 800 jaar gelede die begin van die vroegste alfabet
laat_vaar_vorige.na: was dit die begin van die vroegste alfabet, sowat 3 800 jaar gelede
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: The time phrase wedged between 'dit' and 'die begin' makes the sentence hard to follow; placing it at the end reads naturally.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: Time before the predicate is normal Afrikaans word order and the original reads correctly; the proposal is a lateral reorder.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Daaruit kom die Griekse letters en later ook ons letters.
laat_vaar_vorige.na: Daaruit het die Griekse letters ontstaan en later ook ons letters.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: Present-tense 'kom' clashes with 'later' in a past-tense account; 'het ... ontstaan' keeps the tense consistent.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'Daaruit kom' is a natural present-tense statement of origin, and the proposal leaves 'en later ook ons letters' dangling after the participle, so it is not clearly better.
